items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he wasn't a rock type of drummer you could drive a truck over and he wouldn't budge like Mel Lewis was.

ctx.x: I think his own taste tended to be more aggressive than some of the people he worked for.
Um-hm, but I never thought he was aggressive enough in a big band, he wasn't a rock type of drummer you could drive a truck over and he wouldn't budge like Mel Lewis was.
